en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large alpine youth summer camp or colony. In the foreground many boys are gathered on a grass field with simple sports equipment and a wire fence. Behind them stand several large, plain buildings with tiled roofs and, further right, a small church with a steeple. A tall flagpole with a flag featuring a central symbol stands in the middle of the camp. Mountains and forested hills form the background. At the bottom border of the card, captions identify the location and name of the colony.
